steps.content: It's a strange sight. If it isn't for the tension between you and Stargazer, some eccentric artist must be willing to paint this scene for you.
While the armed mob of raspy-voiced miscreants try to break through the shield at the beleaguered base station, a tense face-off quietly unfolds on the abandoned statue nearby.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: There are two paths before you, my little monster.
Stargazer is smiling, but you can sense the veiled threat in her tone.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: My prophecies are coming true one by one. A lost path, a cast of villains, a disaster... death will soon come up next. You can choose to either seek my help, or to resist...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: For example... To avoid dying here, you can bind me with your shackles and let me handle those who have mutated into monsters.

options: Is this your prophecy or a conspiracy?

choices.text: Is this your prophecy or a conspiracy?

steps.content: You must know that if I use my shackles here, I'll be swallowed by DisSea. After what those people and you have done, the shield is already on the verge of collapse.
Stargazer smiled and pulled you deeper into her embrace.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Isn't that good?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: A skimmer can't trap fine grains of sand, just like this world can't trap you and me. We can walk into the Mirage of Truth together...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You can no longer go back, little monster.
Stargazer pressed against your ear. Her warm breath grazed the tips of your hair, making you shudder.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No matter how hard you struggle, it will all descend.
I just don't believe in prophesied fate, nor do I accept arrangements by others.
I can resolve everything, whether it's them... or you.
Stargazer pressed her head to the side of your neck and giggled as if she heard something funny.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hahaha... Oh my little monster, are you trying to amuse me?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: In this world, everyone indulges in the jubilance of falsehood. They discard the weak and grovel for wealth under whatever pretext, before finally drowning in the reality they've woven.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Only you... You appeared in my dream, in the purest of places, and you've put aside everything in your way... You have the desire to seek the truth.
Stargazer stared at you deeply, as if to find the path to truth in your eyes.
Why did you choose me?
Because I appeared in your dreams? Or because I witnessed the Dreamflower's slumber with you?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I think that's more than enough reason... little monster, you're a special one.
I cannot accept such a reason.
Even if this world is false, it has bestowed upon me responsibility... And for that, I will not abandon it.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Every day... every day... you are surrounded by lies.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Do you think your companions have kept no secrets from you?
Stargazer spun the crystal ball in her hand. The dark mist inside twisted and turned, gradually spreading to form a wasteland.

steps.speaker: Strange Roars
steps.content: Roarrrr...!! Ahhh...!!
Unable to get to the treasures behind the shield, the Hypercube smugglers screech in frustration.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Outta my way, morons! You dumb ****!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: There's no **** way you can get these without me!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: These are all mine alone! You won't even get close to my ****!

steps.speaker: Smuggler A
steps.content: ***! These are mine! No one can **** take them away, ****, not even you!

steps.speaker: Smuggler B
steps.content: Hell no!! Hell no!!
Restrained in place, you can only watch as they grow ever more berserk.
Are you using your powers? They wouldn't be killing each other otherwise!

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Indeed, perhaps it is divine will that our kind can peer into people's hearts...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Thus I did gain some kind of power by peering into a corner of the Void.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: However... the desires of the human heart are all too easily exposed.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You say that I used my power to make them fight?
Stargazer brought the crystal ball before you. You saw the dark mist rolling inside it, but felt no fluctuations from her power.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I don't need to use any powers at all... Just whisper a few words in their ears, and they will reveal their rawest desires like an open book.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: There are countless people like them in this world. They are everywhere around you! Why do you think they fear me and want you to suppress me?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Think about those around you, my dear. Why have they fallen? Why do they avert their gaze from me?
You remembered how the people looked at you and Stargazer back at the WhiteSands shelter and Syndicate black market. You recalled their eyes, filled with awe, fear... and hatred.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They've hidden many things from you. That's why they feel guilty.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: All those people in that city... Surely you aren't naive enough to believe that they are all your friends?

options: You're right. I don't trust them.

choices.text: You're right. I don't trust them.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Mankind is prone to holding blind faith. Once they realize they've put faith in a false made-up deity, the world will march towards destruction.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The shattering of the deity will bring devastating damage. You'll be riddled with scars, little monster.
No one can live in this world in one piece, Miss Stargazer.
You can't guarantee that I'll be unscathed even in the Realm of Truth.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No, you can trust me!
Doesn't your unshakable trust in the Dreamflower count as blind faith as well?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: What an unexpected answer.
There is no such thing as unshakable trust in this world.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: That's right. There isn't.
But there is unshakable bond.
The bond may be between people, or between someone and something.

It's true they're not completely loyal to me, but when it comes to "protecting", we can temporarily put aside our doubts, calculations, and disdain to each other, and form a type of unbreakable "trust."
Stargazer lowered her head, obscuring her expression.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You have a way with words... even if these words are filled with blind ignorance.
I don't care why the Dreamflower chose me, but I know why destiny chose me here in this reality.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: O you who have been blinded...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Haven't you ever considered... that you, who is created by this world, are also a false one?
What did you say?
Stargazer's face is now as cold as the moon rising over WhiteSands. You've never seen her so serious before.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Oh my little monster... My dear Chief of MBCC...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Are you... someone who really, truly exists here?
Her whispers rang in your ears, but before you could ask her what she means, she loosened her grip on you.
You can suddenly breathe smoothly again. The pungent DisSea air floods your nostrils, plunging you into a fit of coughs.
Cough...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: In that case, let me ask you one more time.
With a flick of her wrist, the last star card drawn in the interrogation room appeared in Stargazer's right hand.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Will you continue to bear this false and invisible destiny, or will you join me on the path of truth?
With a card in hand, Stargazer approached you step by step. The awe exuding from her body inadvertently made you take a step backward...
Oh no...!
Misjudging the statue's proportions, your foot landed in the air and you fell backward.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Don't run, my little monster.
The person in front of you reached out and grabbed your collar, leaving you suspended above the ruins.
Her sharp fingernails scraped across your cheeks. Amidst the stinging pain, you felt a small stream trickle down your face.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You despise my prophesying game and want to overturn my predictions. Yet now, your life is literally in my hands.

The Broken Frontline's shield shattered. Bearing the full brunt of DisSea's contamination, the infected attackers rapidly devolved into Corruptors. As their consciousness dissipates, Hypercubes no longer attract them. They turned to... you.
As madness eclipsed greed, they now thirst for your blood more than they did for Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They're coming, and they'll devour you if I let go. If you use your shackles... I'll be quite happy. Let's answer DisSea's calls together. They'll embrace our truest selves, just like the Dreamflower...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: So, will you become my companion?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I'll save you from being devoured by the ants, and from hanging on the branches...
Thank you for your kind offer, but...
The jacket sheathing your arm slipped off, revealing the pistol in your hand that you have been hiding.
I choose to overturn the prophecy by myself.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: What are you doing?!
You clench the hand gripping onto you and press the muzzle of your gun against it.
You pull the trigger without hesitation, making Stargazer lose her grip immediately.
The gunshot reverberates painfully in your ears and brain. You watch your surroundings whirl by as the Corruptors' noises become clearer and clearer.
I won.
You're not sure if you managed to say this out loud, but you did your best to express it during your fall.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: So this is your answer?
I have the right to shoot in defense against a Sinner's threat.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Don't you... have an easier way?
Are you trying to direct me to use my shackles?
I don't know what you're plotting, but I have my own principles... In other words, I don't think it's the right time to use the shackles.
Stargazer's usual smile has gone. She looks at you coldly as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: In that case... Farewell, little monster.
Stargazer let go of her grip, and you were immediately immersed by the weightlessness of falling.
As you slammed into the rotting bodies, you caught a glimpse of Stargazer's eyes before the surging Corruptors completely enveloped you.
They are madly purple, just like the door at the end of the path to the Realm of Truth.
